---
title: "New York Weather Dashboard"
author: "Yiman Rui"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
library(flexdashboard)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

```


```{r}
data("ny_noaa")

central_park_weather =
  ny_noaa %>%
  filter(id == "USW00094728") %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")),
    month = factor(
      month.abb[as.integer(format(date, "%m"))],
      levels = month.abb
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin)
  )

set.seed(8105)

scatter_weather =
  central_park_weather %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1500)

yearly_weather =
  central_park_weather %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatterplot

```{r}
scatter_weather |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Line plot
```{r}
yearly_weather %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year, y = ~mean_tmax,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```



### Boxplot
```{r}
central_park_weather %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, y = ~tmax,
    type = "box", color = ~month,
    colors = "viridis", showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)")
  )
```
